summary: Natuzzi S.p.A., a foreign private issuer, filed its Form 6-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results and disclosed a comprehensive restructuring. The company is reducing Italian plants from five to two, relocating production to Romania, offering voluntary exits to 120 employees, and received a binding offer for an industrial asset with ~40 employees transferring. An independent expert was appointed for a negotiated crisis settlement under Italian law. The restructuring aims to cut costs amid weak demand. No deal terms disclosed; watch for further asset sales and regulatory/labor approvals.
